newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian rates steady, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Croatian rates steady, trade slow.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates were steady in sluggish Thursday morning trade, amid weak demand for kuna funds.
"Demand for funds was low. The market today experienced a near standstill, as opposed to Wednesday's brisk trade," a dealer said.
Fresh loans were estimated at 4 million kuna, of which 3 million were call money loans at a steady 11-percent rate and the rest were two short-term borrowings granted at 14 and 16 percent.
Wednesday's overnight trade totalled 25.7 million kuna, sought by one bank to square its position. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
